Paper Title: Surface hydroxylation engineering to boost oxygen evolution reaction on IrO2/TiO2 for PEM water electrolyzer
Journal: Applied Catalysis B: Environment and Energy
Notes: Directly studies IrO₂/TiO₂ OER catalysts for PEMWE, showing how support surface chemistry (OH-rich titanate / hydroxylation) tunes hypervalent Ir species, η₁₀ (247 mV at 10 mA cm⁻²), ECSA and PEM cell performance (1.787 V at 2 A cm⁻², 0.08 g_Ir kW⁻¹, 350 h).

Paper Title: Formation of Core-Shell Ir@TiO2 Nanoparticles through Hydrogen Treatment as Acidic Oxygen Evolution Reaction Catalysts
Notes: relevant for Ir loading and morphology (core–shell vs mixed) and activity–stability trade-off (S-number, η-drift) on a TiO₂-based support in acidic media.

Paper Title: Amorphous iridium oxide coating on TiO2 for efficient electrocatalytic oxygen evolution reaction
Notes: addresses how amorphous Ir shell + TiO₂ support and low Ir loading affect η₁₀, ECSA, C_dl, R_ct, TOF and durability

Paper Title: Iridium-titanium oxides for efficient oxygen evolution reaction in acidic media
Notes: Gives a mechanistic view of Ir–Ti mixing vs phase-segregated IrO₂/TiO₂, linking composition and structure evolution to OER activity, η₁₀ and long-term stability in acid.

Paper Title: Iridium Oxide Network on Non-conductive TiO2 Support as a Catalyst for Oxygen Evolution Reaction
Notes: shows how network formation on TiO₂ controls mass activity and Ir utilization without changing the chemical nature of the support.
